description: Builds the one link that puts the chosen lines in the guest's cart on experiencebamfield.com, and checks it: the lines it opens with, any that would be left out and why, and the totals. Give the guest the url. They review the cart and pay by card; the booking is confirmed the moment they pay. A fishing charter is not carried by the link: it is added from its own page.

boatLengthFt.description: Moorage only: the boat's length in feet.

endDate.description: Last day: the morning the guests leave for a stay or moorage; the return day for a rental (the same date for a rental within one day).

endTime.description: Boats only: return time, HH:MM, by 20:00.

guests.description: How many people. Checked against how many a cottage sleeps. Default 2.

quantity.description: Boats, vehicles or charter trips. 1 for a cottage. Default 1.

startDate.description: First day: check-in for a stay, pick-up day for a rental.

startTime.description: Boats only: pick-up time, HH:MM, from 07:00. Send both times or neither.

name: build_cart_link

url.description: The link to give the guest. Null when no line would open: there is nothing to hand over.

title: The link to give the guest
